flagged.evidence: The definition gives, for n=3, C̄₁(t) = [[−t, 1], [0, 1]] and claims conjugacy to the fixed reduced Burau matrices by P = I−S. The current def-reduced-burau-representation fixes bᵢ = tⁱ(hᵢ−hᵢ₊₁) as its matrix basis; thm-topological-and-matrix-burau-representations-agree identifies this with its gᵢ basis and gives ρ̄₃(σ₁) = [[−t, t], [0, 1]]. For P = [[1, 0], [−1, 1]], PC̄₁P⁻¹ = [[1−t, 1], [t, 0]], while P⁻¹C̄₁P = [[−t−1, 1], [−t−2, 2]]; neither is the stated fixed-basis matrix. The claimed conjugation omits the basis scaling.

[F1] says ρ̄ₙ(β) is the action matrix in the hᵢ = εᵢ−εₙ basis. The current def-reduced-burau-representation instead defines ρ̄ₙ using the fixed bᵢ basis and says hᵢ gives conjugate matrices; thm-topological-and-matrix-burau-representations-agree confirms this with its n=3 fixed-basis matrix. Thus [F1] misidentifies the cited matrix, and Proof 2.1's identification of Rᵢ with ρ̄ₙ and the conjugation by P omit the basis scaling. The determinant comparison may hold after the correct basis change, but this fact and its use are not licensed as written.

Step 2.1 concludes that the surviving factors from Z[t] are irreducible in Λ, citing [F1, F3, F4, step 1.2]. Those establish factorization in Z[t] and localization, but do not yet establish that the surviving irreducibles remain irreducible after localization; that is proved later in step 3.1. A reader can close this proof-order gap using step 3.1, so it is nonfatal.
